name: a dusty stetson
description: A wide-brimmed felt hat, sweat-stained at the band and dusty everywhere else. Made for tipping.

name: a coiled lasso
description: A stiff loop of braided rope, coiled neatly and tied off with a thong.

name: a dented canteen
description: A tin canteen in a wool cover, dented from more than one fall off a saddle. It sloshes when shaken.

name: a deck of cards
description: A well-thumbed deck with soft corners. You'd bet a dollar at least one ace is marked.

name: a bottle of whiskey
description: Amber rotgut in a squat brown bottle, the label long since peeled away.
